title: Morning Brief — Sunday, 15 November 2026
description: New aged care resident protections take effect nationally, Queensland's export award winners head to next week's national finals in Canberra, and the Gold Coast's airport progresses its 20-year master plan ahead of the 2032 Olympics. 한국어 방송도 이어집니다.
